game.title: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth
game.blurb: Action RPG from Square Enix, the second part of the Final Fantasy VII remake project, released 2024-02-29 (PC 2024-12-12). RAWG average playtime: 71 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Cloud and friends leave Midgar behind and follow Sephiroth's trail across the world.

chapters.title: Combat and Growth
chapters.summary: Weaknesses, staggers, synergy skills, limit breaks, summons, weapon abilities and materia.

chapters.title: Exploring the Regions
chapters.summary: World intel, chocobo stops, caches, buried treasure, side quests and the moogle emporium.

chapters.title: Minigames and Queen's Blood
chapters.summary: Queen's Blood, the piano and the many minigames along the way.

chapters.title: Chadley, Summons and Endgame
chapters.summary: Chadley's materia research, summon battles, combat simulations, level 70 and mastering every skill.

StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Final_Fantasy_VII_Rebirth
Fandom (finalfantasy.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://finalfantasy.fandom.com/wiki/Final_Fantasy_VII_Rebirth
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough, Gameplay, Controls and Trophies subpages are linked but not written, and only a Table of Contents subpage exists. finalfantasy.fandom.com answers the API, with 500 linked pages (the API limit, so likely more); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "EP2P" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2909400. 33 of 61 Steam achievements are hidden. Four hidden ones whose names clearly point at minigames (Fort Condor Commander, Cactuar Crusher, Card Royalty, Polygonal Prizefighter) are sorted into the minigames chapter by name; the rest sit in the main story chapter, although several (for example the star-rating set, Are You Not Entertained?, Hall of Famer) are probably minigames or side content too and need checking.
